title: Roasted Squash and Israeli Couscous Salad
subtitle: with peas, herbs and walnuts
description: Israeli couscous seasoned with cumin and baharat, tossed with roasted pumpkin and red onion, peas and herbs in a date syrup, chilli and lemon dressing, topped with walnuts.

steps.text: Cook the Israeli couscous according to the packet instructions with the water. Season with cumin and baharat.

Preheat the oven to 250°C. Arrange the peeled pumpkin slices (1.5 cm thick) and the red onion cut into sixths on a baking tray lined with baking paper. Season with salt and pepper and roast for about 25 minutes until golden and soft.
Blanch the peas in boiling water for about 2 minutes, transfer to iced water and drain.
For the dressing, mix the chopped chilli in a small bowl with the date syrup, lemon juice and olive oil.
Pick the herb leaves and roughly chop the walnuts. Toss the roasted vegetables, herbs, peas, seasoned couscous and dressing together. Top with walnuts and, if you like, crumbled labneh.
